06-18-1901 is June 18, 1901.  
Subtract 40 weeks = 280 days.  
Subtract 6 more days = total 286 days before June 18, 1901.  

1901 is not a leap year (divisible by 100, not by 400).  
Days back from June 18:  
June 18 → May 31 = 18 days (286 - 18 = 268 left)  
May has 31 days, April 30, March 31, February 28, January 31.  

Count backward:  
May 31 back 268 days:  
May: 31 days → back to May 1 (31 days) → 268 - 30 = 238 left (since May 1 to May 31 is 31 days, going back from May 31 to May 1 uses 30 days? Let's recalc carefully.)  

Better: From June 18, subtract 286 days.  
Days in months before June 1901:  
May 31, Apr 30, Mar 31, Feb 28, Jan 31, Dec 31, Nov 30, Oct 31, Sep 30, Aug 31, Jul 31.  

Count backward:  
June 18 → May 31: 18 days (286 - 18 = 268)  
May: 31 days → back to May 1: 30 more days (268 - 30 = 238)  
April: 30 days → back to Apr 1: 29 more days (238 - 29 = 209)  
March: 31 days → back to Mar 1: 30 more days (209 - 30 = 179)  
February: 28 days → back to Feb 1: 27 more days (179 - 27 = 152)  
January: 31 days → back to Jan 1: 30 more days (152 - 30 = 122)  
Now in previous year 1900 (leap? 1900 not leap year).  

December 1900: 31 days → back to Dec 1: 30 more days (122 - 30 = 92)  
November 1900: 30 days → back to Nov 1: 29 more days (92 - 29 = 63)  
October 1900: 31 days → back to Oct 1: 30
